HTML 转 PDF——按 A4 逐页切片，脚本不执行、外链不下载Convert HTML to PDF as A4 page slices — scripts never run, remote assets are never fetched

这条路有两层保护和一个取舍。保护一是净化：文档先过 DOMPurify（保留 head 与 <style>，移除脚本），再在隐藏的 iframe 里渲染，而 iframe 的 sandbox 只给 allow-same-origin——脚本没有执行余地。保护二是离线：净化会保留远程 URL，所以渲染前还有一道把远程引用剥掉的步骤，一张远程图不会把「不联网」这条承诺破掉。取舍是产出形态：结果是渲染出来的位图按 A4 切片，页面里没有文字层，所以搜索、复制、朗读都拿不到文字。这一条对本站所有「文档转 PDF」链路都成立。This route has two protections and one trade-off. The first is sanitisation: the document passes DOMPurify (keeping head and <style>, removing scripts) and is then rendered inside a hidden iframe whose sandbox grants allow-same-origin only, so a script has nowhere to run. The second is the offline promise: sanitising keeps remote URLs, so a further pass strips remote references before rendering — one remote <img> cannot break the no-network claim. The trade-off is what comes out: rendered pixels sliced onto A4, with no text layer, so search, copy and read-aloud find nothing. That holds for every document-to-PDF route here.

会保留什么What carries over

  • 整份文档按 800 px 版心排版，高度全部保留并切成 A4（210 × 297 mm）逐页写入，不是一张拉长的单页图The whole document lays out at an 800 px measure and its full height is kept, sliced onto A4 pages (210 × 297 mm) rather than stretched into one long page
  • 文档自己的 CSS 生效（head 与 <style> 都留着），同时通过沙箱 iframe 隔离，页面样式不会污染工作台The document’s own CSS applies (head and <style> are kept) inside a sandboxed iframe, so page styles cannot leak into the workbench
  • 切片是 PNG 且用 zlib 9 + Paeth：实测十个文档形状里它每一份都比 FAST 档小 1%–8%，文字与数据页比 JPEG 切片小 13%–31%Slices are PNG at zlib level 9 with a Paeth predictor: across the ten measured document shapes it beat the FAST level every time by 1%–8%, and text and data pages came out 13%–31% smaller than a JPEG slice
  • 图片与字体落定后才截图：先等加载，必要时再停 100 ms 让布局落定（只在真有图片、字体或动效的文档上等）Images and fonts settle before capture: the loader waits, and where a document genuinely has images, fonts or motion it pauses another 100 ms for layout
  • 取消以「一页」为粒度：每切一页检查一次中断，两个画布在退出时都会释放Cancellation has page granularity: the abort signal is checked before every slice and both canvases are released on the way out

如实说明的限制What it does not do

  • 没有文字层：PDF 里的字是画出来的，搜索、复制、屏幕阅读器都取不到内容There is no text layer: the characters are drawn, so search, copy and screen readers find nothing to work with
  • 远程资源在渲染前被剥掉（data: / blob: / 相对路径保留），远程图片、远程字体与远程 CSS 都不会下载Remote resources are stripped before rendering (data:, blob: and relative references remain), so remote images, fonts and stylesheets are never downloaded
  • 长文档像素比会降：高度超过 2000 px 用 1.5 倍、超过 4000 px 用 1 倍，超长页的字不如短页锐利Long documents drop resolution: past 2000 px of height the ratio is 1.5× and past 4000 px it is 1×, so very long pages are less crisp than short ones
  • 分页只看高度，不懂「章节起新页」；纸张固定 A4 竖版，不能选横版或其它尺寸Pagination only measures height and does not understand “start a new page per chapter”; the paper is fixed portrait A4 with no size or orientation choice

实操提示Working with it

  • 目标是 PDF 时输出参数面板不出现（那是为图片准备的），DPI 只在来源是 PDF 时才有意义The output panel is not offered for a PDF target (it belongs to image targets), and DPI matters only when the source is a PDF
  • 单个文件 100 MB、一批最多 200 个；文档在 10 秒内没加载完只报该文件超时，批次里其余继续100 MB per file and up to 200 files per batch; a document that never finishes loading inside 10 seconds reports its own timeout while the batch continues

常见问题Questions people actually ask

为什么 PDF 里选不中文字？Why can I not select the text in the PDF?

因为产物是渲染出来的位图。本站的所有 PDF 输出都走渲染这条路（HTML 是其中唯一能排版的中间格式），没有文字层生成路径；要可检索的文字，就交付 HTML、Markdown 或 Word。Because the artifact is rendered pixels. Every PDF this tool emits goes through that rendering path — HTML is its only typesetting intermediate — and there is no text-layer generator to call. For searchable text, deliver HTML, Markdown or Word instead.

为什么图片不见了？Why did the images vanish?

远程引用在渲染前被剥掉了，这是离线承诺的必要部分。把图片内联成 data URI，或让它们以相对路径与 HTML 同目录，就会出现在 PDF 里。Remote references are stripped before rendering — that is what keeps the offline promise. Inline the images as data URIs or let them sit beside the HTML as relative paths and they will appear in the PDF.

能控制纸张大小或分页位置吗？Can I choose the paper size or where pages break?

不能：A4 竖版、按高度切。需要精确分页位置时，在源 HTML 里控制块的高度与间距（比如给章节留出足够的块），或转成 PDF 后在 PDF 编辑器里重排。No: portrait A4, sliced by height. To influence where a break lands, control block heights and spacing in the source HTML (give a section enough vertical mass), or re-impose the PDF afterwards in a PDF editor.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
